title: The Drowned Procession
text: The drowned walk out of the river in their Sunday clothes, in a slow procession toward the Rift Gate. As they pass they knock at every House's door, asking for the ones they lost.

options.label: Open the door and hear the names they ask for.

outcomes.text: They name a long-dead ancestor of the House and bow to the hall. The water they leave behind is clean.
They name one of your living and wait. At last they go, but that Scion has dreamed of deep water every night since.

options.label: Bar the door and wait for dawn; the drowned can ask elsewhere.

outcomes.text: Wet handprints dry on the door. However it is scrubbed, they are still there in spring.
The knocking goes on all night. Everyone inside hears their mother's voice in it.

options.label: Follow the drowned to the Gate to learn what they mean to do there.

outcomes.text: At the Gate they turn and give back what the river took: coins, rings, a sword green with weed.
A Scion walked too far with them, and coughed up river silt for a month after.
